'''Facundo''' "'''Facu'''" '''Campazzo Avedano''' (born 23 March 1991) is an Argentine professional [[basketball]] player for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]]. At a height of {{height|ft=5|in=10}} tall,{{Cite web |url=http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=1LU |title=Facu Campazzo nombre completo: Facundo Campazzo altura: 1.81 m |language=es |access-date=24 October 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141008021450/http://acb.com/jugador.php?id=1LU |archive-date=8 October 2014 |url-status=dead }}[https://web.archive.org/web/20140908174139/http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/gamecent/p/pid/6047462/playerview.html Facundo CAMPAZZO | Position : 1 Size : 181.] he plays at the [[point guard]] position. He is also a member of the senior [[Argentina men's national basketball team|Argentina national basketball team]]. As a member of Real Madrid, Campazzo earned an [[All-EuroLeague Team|All-EuroLeague First Team]] selection in [[2023–24 EuroLeague|2024]] and won two [[EuroLeague]] championships in [[2015 EuroLeague Final Four|2015]] and [[2018 EuroLeague Final Four|2018]]. While representing Argentina, he played a crucial role on the way of a silver medal at the [[2019 FIBA World Cup]]. ==Professional career== ===Peñarol (2008–2014)=== [[File:Facundo campazzo.JPG|thumb|Campazzo with Peñarol in 2009]] Campazzo began playing for the [[Argentine National Basketball League|Argentine League]] club [[Peñarol de Mar del Plata]] in 2008.[http://faltayvale.blogspot.it/2008/09/puntero-invicto-del-grupo-v-en-la-copa.html Faltayvale.it Puntero invicto del grupo V en la Copa Argentina {{in lang|it}}.] With Peñarol, he won the following tournaments: the [[Argentine Basketball League|Argentine League]] championship four times (2010, 2011, 2012, 2014), the [[Argentine Basketball Cup|Argentine Cup]] (2010), the Argentine Challenge Cup (2010), the [[Super 8 Tournament (basketball)|Argentine Super 8 Tournament]] three times (2009, 2011, 2013), the [[InterLeagues Tournament]] twice (2010, 2012), and the [[FIBA Americas League]] championship ([[2009–10 FIBA Americas League|2010]]). He was named the [[Argentine Basketball League Revelation of the Year|Argentine League Revelation of the Year]] and the Argentine Cup MVP in 2010. He was named the Argentine Super 8 Tournament MVP in 2011 and 2013 and the [[Argentine Basketball League Most Improved Player|Argentine League Most Improved Player]] in 2012. He was also named the [[Argentine Basketball League Finals MVP|Argentine League Finals MVP]] in 2012 and 2014. ===Real Madrid (2014–2020)=== On 30 August 2014, Campazzo signed a three-year deal with the [[Liga ACB|Spanish League]] club [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].{{cite news|title=Real Madrid adds Campazzo at point|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/140301/180|access-date=30 August 2014|work=Euroleague.net}} In the [[2014–15 Euroleague|2014–15 season]], Real Madrid won the [[EuroLeague]] championship, after defeating the Greek club [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]], by a score of 78–59, in [[2015 EuroLeague Final Four|the league's final game]].{{cite news|title=Real Madrid is Euroleague champion for record ninth time!|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=251&seasoncode=E2014#!report|access-date=18 July 2015|work=euroleague.net|date=17 May 2015}} Real Madrid eventually finished the season by winning the [[Liga ACB|Spanish ACB League]]'s [[2014–15 ACB season|2014–15 season]]'s league playoff finals, after a 3–0 series sweep in the finals series against [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|Barcelona]]. By winning that title, Real Madrid also won the [[European Basketball Triple Crown|triple crown]].{{cite news|title=Real Madrid make it 4 out of 4|url=http://www.marca.com/en/2015/06/24/en/football/real_madrid/1435176357.html|access-date=24 June 2015|work=marca.com|date=24 June 2015|language=es}} On 20 August 2015, Campazzo was [[loan (sports)|loaned]] to Spanish club [[CB Murcia|UCAM Murcia]].{{cite news|title=UCAM Murcia announces Facundo Campazzo|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/173342/ucam-murcia-announces-facundo-campazzo.html|access-date=20 August 2015|work=Sportando.com|date=20 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150912182243/http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/173342/ucam-murcia-announces-facundo-campazzo.html|archive-date=12 September 2015|url-status=dead}} He spent both the [[2015–16 ACB season]], and the [[2016–17 ACB season]] with Murcia. He returned to Real Madrid for the [[2017–18 ACB season]]. In May 2018, Real Madrid won the [[2017–18 EuroLeague]] season's championship after defeating the Turkish club [[Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball|Fenerbahçe Doğuş]] in the [[2018 EuroLeague Final Four|finals]], by a score of 85–80.{{cite news|title=Real Madrid is 2018 EuroLeague champion|url=http://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=260&seasoncode=E2017#!report|access-date=20 May 2018|work=euroleague.net|date=20 May 2018}} Over 30 EuroLeague games played, Campazzo averaged 7.9 points, 4.5 assists and 2.4 rebounds per game. On 24 May 2018, he finished in fourth place in voting for the Spanish Liga ACB's [[ACB Most Valuable Player Award|MVP award]] of the [[2017–18 ACB season|2017–18 season]].{{cite news|title=Luka Doncic, MVP Movistar de la Liga Endesa 2017-18|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=140829|access-date=26 May 2018|work=ACB.com|date=24 May 2018|language=es|archive-date=27 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190627000539/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=140829|url-status=dead}} On 26 June 2018, he re-signed to a three-year deal with [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].{{cite news |title=Madrid re-signs Campazzo to three-year deal |url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/8tv4hx9ycv5xgvay |access-date=26 June 2018 |work=EuroLeague.net |date=26 June 2018}} On 3 May 2019, he was named the [[EuroLeague MVP of the Month|EuroLeague MVP for the month of April]]. In the third place game of the [[2019 EuroLeague Final Four]], Campazzo set an all-time record for assists in a [[EuroLeague Final Four|Final Four]] game, with 15. He surpassed [[Terrell McIntyre]]'s previous record from [[2008 EuroLeague Final Four|2008]].{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/item/9ok8yytrjwu47cx8|title=2019 Turkish Airlines EuroLeague Final Four records review|work=Welcome to EUROLEAGUE BASKETBALL|access-date=3 June 2019}} On 6 February 2020, Campazzo joined [[Stefan Jović]] at the top of the [[EuroLeague records#EuroLeague Basketball records (2001–present)|EuroLeague's all-time single-game assists chart]] after he dished out 19 assists in a 103–97 win over the German club [[Alba Berlin]].{{cite web|url=https://www.euroleague.net/main/results/showgame?gamecode=209&seasoncode=E2019#!report|title=Campazzo ties record as Real sees off ALBA in thriller|website=euroleague.net|access-date=6 February 2020}} ===Denver Nuggets (2020–2022)=== On 30 November 2020, Campazzo was signed by the [[Denver Nuggets]] of the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] to a multiyear contract.{{cite news |title=Denver Nuggets sign Facundo Campazzo to a multiyear contract |url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/campazzo-signs-202011 |access-date=1 December 2020 |work=NBA.com |date=30 November 2020}} On 13 April 2022, Campazzo was suspended for Game 1 of the first round of the [[2022 NBA playoffs]]. The suspension stemmed from him shoving Lakers guard [[Wayne Ellington]] in a game three days earlier.{{Cite web |title=NBA suspends Facundo Campazzo, fines Wayne Ellington |url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-suspends-facundo-campazzo-fines-wayne-ellington |access-date=April 13, 2022 |website=NBA}} === Dallas Mavericks (2022) === On 18 October 2022, Campazzo signed a contract with the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{Cite web|title=Mavericks sign Campazzo, roster full at 17|url=https://www.mavs.com/facu-signs/|access-date=October 18, 2022|website=mavs.com|date=18 October 2022 }} On 28 November 2022, he was waived when the Mavericks signed guard [[Kemba Walker]].{{cite web|title=Mavericks add Kemba Walker to bolster ballhandling|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavs-sign-kemba|date=November 29, 2022|website=mavs.com|access-date=November 29, 2022}} ===Crvena zvezda (2022–2023)=== On 19 December 2022, Campazzo signed a contract with Serbian team [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]].{{cite web |title=Zvanično – Kampaco u Zvezdi! |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/euroleague/vesti.php?yyyy=2022&mm=12&dd=19&nav_id=2260021 |website=b92.net |access-date=19 December 2022}}{{cite web |title=Fakundo Kampaco novi plejmejker Crvene zvezde!!! |url=https://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/2022/12/19/fakundo-kampaco-novi-plejmejker-crvene-zvezde/ |website=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |date=19 December 2022 |access-date=19 December 2022}}{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/kk-crvena-zvezda-officially-signs-facundo-campazzo/|title=KK Crvena Zvezda officially signs Facundo Campazzo|date=December 19, 2022|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=December 19, 2022 |last1=Maggi |first1=Alessandro }} ===Return to Real Madrid (2023–present)=== On July 18, 2023, Campazzo made his official return to [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]] after three seasons, signing a four-year deal.{{cite web|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2023/07/18/official-announcement-campazzo|title=Official Announcement: Campazzo|access-date=18 July 2023 |work=Real Madrid|date=18 July 2023}} On February 18, 2024, Campazzo won his third Spanish Cup with Madrid and was named the tournament's MVP for a second time in his career. He recorded 18 points and 6 assists in the final against [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|Barcelona]].{{Cite web |title=European basketball cups 2024: winners and MVPs |url=https://basketnews.com/news-202052-european-basketball-cups-2024-winners-and-mvps.html |access-date=2024-02-22 |website=basketnews.com |language=en}} On October 4, 2024, Campazzo protested a late no-call and was ejected from the game. His heated reaction was met by his teammates restraining him to avoid further and more intense complaints to the referees.{{cite web |title=Campazzo's reaction attracts a disciplinary proceeding by Euroleague Basketball |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/1723035/disciplinary-proceeding-against-facundo-campazzo-real-madrid-euroleague/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=14 October 2024 |language=en |date=4 October 2024}} It was announced that he received a one-game suspension and a fine.{{cite web |title=Facundo Campazzo gets suspension and fine, Crvena Zvezda also sanctioned |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/1724722/facundo-campazzo-suspension-fine-real-madrid-euroleague/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=14 October 2024 |language=en |date=8 October 2024}} ==National team career== ===Junior national team=== Campazzo was a member of Argentina's junior national teams. With Argentina's under-16 junior national team, he played at the 2007 FIBA South American Under-16 Championship, where he won a gold medal. ===Senior national team=== Campazzo competed for the senior [[Argentina national basketball team]] at the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2012 London Summer Olympics]].[https://web.archive.org/web/20130713085537/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/q/Facundo%20CAMPAZZO/pid/65388/_/players.html FIBA.com Facundo CAMPAZZO (ARG).] He also played for Argentine teams that won gold medals at the [[2012 South American Basketball Championship|2012 South American Championship]] and the [[Basketball at the 2014 South American Games|2014 South American Games]], silver medals at the [[2014 South American Basketball Championship|2014 South American Championship]], the [[2015 FIBA Americas Championship]], and the [[2017 FIBA AmeriCup]], and a bronze medal at the [[2013 FIBA Americas Championship]]. He also played with Argentina at the [[2014 FIBA World Cup]] and at the [[Basketball at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2016 Rio Summer Olympics]]. He helped Argentina bring home a gold medal from the [[Basketball at the 2019 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|2019 Pan American tournament]], which was held in [[Lima]], [[Peru]]. He also won the silver medal at the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup|2019 FIBA World Cup]]. In 2022, Campazzo won the gold medal in the [[2022 FIBA AmeriCup]] held in [[Recife]], [[Brazil]]. He was Argentina's starting [[point guard]] in the tournament. After the final game against Brazil, he was named in the [[FIBA AmeriCup All-Tournament Team|All-Tournament Team]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/americup/2022/news/deck-named-mvp-campazzo-santos-cole-and-banton-named-to-all-star-five|title=Deck named MVP; Campazzo, Santos, Cole and Banton named to All-Star Five|date=12 September 2022|work=fiba.basketball}}{{cite web | url=https://www.ole.com.ar/basquet/gabriel-deck-facundo-campazzo-americup_0_UOmVB89GsY.html | title=Gabriel Deck y Facundo Campazzo: El MVP y quinteto ideal de la Americup | date=12 September 2022 }} Campazzo was named to the [[FIBA AmeriCup]]'s [[FIBA AmeriCup All-Tournament Team|All-Tournament Team]] in 2013, 2017 and 2022. ==Career
